name: Andrea Lisi
title: Senior Software Engineer
subtitle: Web development, frontend platforms and developer tools
profile: I have been building web applications for over 18 years, with deep frontend experience and a background in web design. I write code, build shared resources and work with teams on architecture, performance and developer tools. I have also worked on backend systems and infrastructure.

bullets: I defined shared solutions for the monorepo with developers, engineering managers, principal engineers and product stakeholders.
I built shared libraries and tools and resolved cross-project issues; product teams owned their features. I wrote ADRs and automated checks for repository rules.
I built the infrastructure for design system upgrades, supported teams through migrations and updated shared components and themes myself.
I administered the GitHub repository and automated GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines. I optimized builds and caching and modernized developer tools.
I evaluated Claude, Cursor and other tools on real tasks, maintained repository context and checked the resulting code through review and tests.
I contributed to moving the storefront out of the monolith using React, Vue and GraphQL.
I built interfaces for high-traffic campaigns, working with design and design system teams to match mockups and shared standards.
For the final two years, I was the only frontend developer alongside the backend team, building the back-office from scratch with the people running forestry operations.
I modernized the frontend of a live luxury e-commerce platform, introducing React and Webpack incrementally while continuing to build features.
I worked on the storefront and the internal CMS used for orders and daily operations.
I started by designing and building websites, then also worked on frontend and backend applications, visual identities and print materials.
I installed servers, networks and firewalls for clients in Tuscany's leather and fashion district.
